# Antigravity Design System

> An agent-native, human-centric design system built at the intersection of visual precision, physical intuition, and robust engineering. Powered by React 19, Base UI, Motion, and Tailwind CSS v4.

## Core Architectural Directives

- [Directive 1: Physical Yield on pointerdown](file:///AGENTS.md): Interactive controls compress immediately (scale 0.97 to 0.98) on touch or pointer down without waiting for release.
- [Directive 2: Zero Layout Shifts](file:///AGENTS.md): Layout geometry never alters across dynamic states (hover, focus, active, selected).
- [Directive 3: Tabular Numerals](file:///AGENTS.md): All counters, metrics, dates, and prices declare `tabular-nums` to eliminate glyph jitter.
- [Directive 4: Accessible Invariants](file:///AGENTS.md): Full WCAG 2.2 Level AA compliance, explicit aria-labels on icon controls, and keyboard focus trapping.
- [Directive 6: Concentric Corner Radii](file:///AGENTS.md): Inner radius calculated mathematically as R_inner = max(0, R_outer - Padding).
- [Directive 7: Anti-Crush Responsive Page Architecture](file:///AGENTS.md): Strict minimum column widths and non-collapsing navigation bars.
- [Directive 8: Reversible Kinetic Affordances](file:///AGENTS.md): Kinetic icons only animate when mechanical affordance returns to origin.
- [Directive 11: Perceptual OKLCH Gradient Engineering](file:///AGENTS.md): All gradient ramps interpolate in perceptual color spaces (`in oklch`) with WCAG 2.2 AA and WCAG 3 APCA contrast floors.
- [Directive 12: British English](file:///AGENTS.md): Interface prose and tokens strictly use British English spelling.

## UI Primitives Matrix (51 Components)

### Actions & Toggles
- `Button` (`@/components/ui/button`): Tactile button with 7 visual variants, 4 sizing constraints, async loading state, and pointerdown yield.
- `Toggle` (`@/components/ui/toggle`): Two-state pressed button with tactile physical feedback.
- `ToggleGroup` (`@/components/ui/toggle-group`): Grouped multi-option or single-option toggle toolbar.
- `CopyButton` (`@/components/ui/copy-button`): Clipboard copy button with morphing checkmark feedback.
- `ThemeToggle` (`@/components/ui/theme-toggle`): Instant dark/light mode toggle with transition suppression.
- `SegmentedControl` (`@/components/ui/segmented-control`): iOS-style sliding pill segmented switcher with spring indicator.
- `Toolbar` (`@/components/ui/toolbar`): Compound desktop-grade toolbar container with button groups and separators.
- `MarkdownToolbar` (`@/components/ui/markdown-toolbar`): Full-featured rich markdown authoring toolbar with 20 actions and table generator.

### Forms & Input
- `Input` (`@/components/ui/input`): 16px iOS zoom prevention text input with specular rims and prefix/suffix slots.
- `Textarea` (`@/components/ui/textarea`): Auto-resizing multi-line text input with character counters.
- `Checkbox` (`@/components/ui/checkbox`): Accessible checkbox with check and indeterminate minus icons.
- `Switch` (`@/components/ui/switch`): 44px accessible touch target fluid toggle switch with spring thumb easing.
- `Slider` (`@/components/ui/slider`): Single and dual-thumb range slider with live floating tooltip pills.
- `Stepper` (`@/components/ui/stepper`): Tactile numeric counter with hold-to-accelerate repeat behavior.
- `InputOTP` (`@/components/ui/input-otp`): Segmented PIN verification input with native SMS autofill parsing.
- `Select` (`@/components/ui/select`): Headless Base UI select with liquid glass dropdown menu.
- `Combobox` (`@/components/ui/combobox`): Autocomplete search combobox with keyboard navigation.
- `RadioGroup` (`@/components/ui/radio-group`): WAI-ARIA compliant radio group with animated selection dot.
- `Field` (`@/components/ui/field`): Compound field container coordinating label, description, control, and validation errors.
- `FileUpload` (`@/components/ui/file-upload`): Drag-and-drop file upload zone with progress indicators and file validation.

### Navigation & Menus
- `NavigationBar` (`@/components/ui/navigation-bar`): Top navigation bar with mega menu, categorized columns, and mobile sheet drawer.
- `Breadcrumb` (`@/components/ui/breadcrumb`): Hierarchical navigation breadcrumb trail with kinetic chevrons.
- `Pagination` (`@/components/ui/pagination`): Sliding page indicator with worded and compact icon controls.
- `Tabs` (`@/components/ui/tabs`): Fluid tabs with spring layout indicator glide and zero layout shift.

### Overlays & Surfaces
- `Dialog` (`@/components/ui/dialog`): Modal dialogue with focus trapping, backdrop blur, and escape dismissal.
- `AlertDialog` (`@/components/ui/alert-dialog`): High-friction confirmation modal for destructive operations.
- `Sheet` (`@/components/ui/sheet`): Slide-over drawer from any viewport edge (left, right, top, bottom).
- `Drawer` (`@/components/ui/drawer`): Mobile swipeable bottom sheet with tactile drag handle.
- `Popover` (`@/components/ui/popover`): Floating anchored surface with collision detection.
- `DropdownMenu` (`@/components/ui/dropdown-menu`): Nested context menus with checkbox items, radio groups, and shortcuts.
- `ContextMenu` (`@/components/ui/context-menu`): Secondary right-click desktop menu with submenus.
- `HoverCard` (`@/components/ui/hover-card`): Rich preview card triggered on pointer hover.
- `Tooltip` (`@/components/ui/tooltip`): Micro contextual hint with configurable delay.
- `Command` (`@/components/ui/command`): Global command palette dialog (⌘K) with instant item filtering.

### Data & Feedback
- `Table` (`@/components/ui/table`): Quiet chrome data table with strict tabular numerals.
- `Card` (`@/components/ui/card`): Concentric rounded surface with specular rim lighting and inner card nesting.
- `Badge` (`@/components/ui/badge`): Shrink-wrapped status indicator pill with live pulsing telemetry dots.
- `Avatar` (`@/components/ui/avatar`): User avatar with deterministic OKLCH fallback and presence status pips.
- `Calendar` (`@/components/ui/calendar`): Interactive month grid with spring slide transitions and date pickers.
- `Chart` (`@/components/ui/chart`): Zero-dependency vector Sparklines, AreaCharts, and BarCharts in perceptual OKLCH.
- `ProgressiveImage` (`@/components/ui/image`): Zero-CLS progressive image loader with low-res preview decoding.
- `Kbd` (`@/components/ui/kbd`): Tactile physical keycap micro-primitive.
- `Timeline` (`@/components/ui/timeline`): Chronological audit trail with glowing nodes and pulse indicators.
- `Tree` (`@/components/ui/tree`): Hierarchical recursive folder and file tree with expand/collapse animations.
- `NumberTicker` (`@/components/ui/number-ticker`): Tabular rolling numeral counter with spring deceleration.
- `Progress` (`@/components/ui/progress`): Linear progress bar and circular radial gauge with indeterminate states.
- `Skeleton` (`@/components/ui/skeleton`): Zero-CLS dimensionally stable placeholder loader.
- `Toast` (`@/components/ui/toast`): Non-blocking alert notification with 5-second reversible undo action.
- `Accordion` (`@/components/ui/accordion`): Smooth CSS height accordion with concealed focus sequence.
- `Resizable` (`@/components/ui/resizable`): Split-pane viewport layout with keyboard and drag resize handles.
- `ScrollArea` (`@/components/ui/scroll-area`): Custom styled scrollbar container with cross-browser parity.

## Kinetic Icons (470 Primitives)

Access 470 mechanical animated icons in `@/components/icons`. Every icon exports a canonical mechanical affordance bound to parent hover and press lifecycles.
